applicant-file-completeness.name: Applicant File Completeness
applicant-file-completeness.description: From their applicant folder index, list each applicant for the opening they named and which required forms are present or missing.

handbook-ack-missing.name: Handbook Ack Missing
handbook-ack-missing.description: Compare the live handbook version string to each acknowledgment on their roster or ack sheet.

i9-section-dates.name: I9 Section Dates
i9-section-dates.description: Build a date list from their I-9 index: name, start date, Section 1 date, Section 2 date, and reverify date if they track one.

new-hire-completeness.name: New Hire Completeness
new-hire-completeness.description: Read their new-hire checklist sheet and the packet folder. Mark each row present, missing, or not-applicable as they allow.

offboard-checklist.name: Offboard Checklist
offboard-checklist.description: Use their termination checklist only after they already wrote a last day. Compare the issue log and org chart for remaining tasks.

poster-and-handbook-version.name: Poster And Handbook Version
poster-and-handbook-version.description: Read their poster index and the live handbook PDF. List poster files or wall-check dates plus the handbook version string.

pto-log.name: Pto Log
pto-log.description: List balances and requests from their PTO sheet. Keep their column names; you do not approve or deny.

reverify-dates.name: Reverify Dates
reverify-dates.description: From their I-9 index, list people with a reverify-by date and whether that date is past on the calendar they use.

training-due.name: Training Due
training-due.description: Read their training log. List people with a due or refresh date on or before the pack date they asked for.
